acceptance: Measured CI runtime of the comment-policy job (median and p95 over recent runs) recorded in the PR
The job stays under its timeout with margin, by speeding up the check (for example caching the isolated venv, or scanning only changed files on PRs) or by a justified timeout change
No comment-policy timeout across 20 consecutive PR runs after the change
context: Found while landing #3083 and #3092 in the tuning-local fix batch (2026-10-17).
description: The `comment-policy` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml (job at line 22, `timeout-minutes: 10` at line 24) timed out with no findings on two unrelated PRs on 2026-10-17: #3083 run 39012350807 ("The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 10m0s"), and #3092 run 39051349806, where it ran 10m8s and the run was cancelled. Both passed on a plain rerun. Locally, `make comment-policy-check` took 5m21s on a quiet host. So the job's runtime sits near its limit, and runner variance pushes it over. Each timeout blocks the `tooling` and `core` aggregates until someone reruns it by hand.
